``choice`` is one of the offered ``approval`` choices (once / session / always / deny); ``all``
resolves every pending approval, ``request_id`` a specific one, neither the oldest.

AutoContinue.title: AutoContinue

BillingChargeResult.title: BillingChargeResult

BillingChargeStatusResult.title: BillingChargeStatusResult

BillingMutationResult.description: A write with no success payload beyond ``ok``.
BillingMutationResult.title: BillingMutationResult

``email``; ``unknown`` carries what the server called it in ``raw_kind``).
BillingPaymentMethod.title: BillingPaymentMethod

BillingPendingChangeResult.title: BillingPendingChangeResult

``_serialize_billing_state`` (money as strings); the ``except`` fallback emits only
``ok / logged_in / free_tier / error``, so everything else is optional.

BillingStepUpResult.title: BillingStepUpResult

ChangeSignalPayload.title: ChangeSignalPayload

ClarifyLockResult.description:
``remaining`` lists the qids still unanswered; the lock that empties it resolves the request.
``expired``: the wait already ended (timeout / cancel) — not an error.

ClarifyRequestParams.description:
Single question: ``question`` / ``choices`` (/ ``multi_select``); batch: ``questions``.
``answers`` rides only on a reconnect replay (locks the server already accepted).

ClarifyResult.description:
Single: ``{answer}`` ('' = skip). Batch: ``{answers}`` for the whole set (early locks go through
the ``clarify.lock`` RPC); a response with neither is cancel-all.
ClarifyResult.title: ClarifyResult

CommandDispatchResult.description:
One structured directive: ``exec``/``plugin`` carry ``output``; ``alias`` a ``target``;
``send``/``prefill``/``skill`` a ``message`` (UIs render ``display``, never ``message``).
CommandDispatchResult.title: CommandDispatchResult

CompletePathParams.description:
``word`` is the token under the cursor (``@`` prefix = context reference); ``cwd`` /
``session_id`` pick the directory the listing resolves against.
CompletePathParams.title: CompletePathParams

CompleteSlashResult.description: ``replace_from`` is the column the accepted item replaces from.
CompleteSlashResult.title: CompleteSlashResult

CompletionItem.description: One popover row; ``kind`` rides only on slash completions (command vs skill).
CompletionItem.title: CompletionItem

ConfigGetParams.description:
``key`` selects one getter from ``_CONFIG_GETTERS``; ``cwd`` feeds the ``project`` getter,
``session_id`` lets ``reasoning`` / ``fast`` answer with the session's live pin.
ConfigGetParams.title: ConfigGetParams

ConfigGetResult.description:
Union of every getter's payload: ``value`` for the simple words, ``config`` for ``full``,
``mtime`` / ``mcp_rev`` for the poller, ``model`` / ``provider`` / ``providers`` for ``provider``,
``home`` / ``display`` for ``profile``, ``cwd`` / ``branch`` for ``project``, ``prompt``.
ConfigGetResult.title: ConfigGetResult

ConfigSetParams.title: ConfigSetParams

ConfigSetResult.description:
``{key, value}`` plus the setter's extras: model switches add ``warning`` /
``confirm_required`` / ``confirm_message`` / ``scope`` / ``deferred``; ``focus`` adds
``tool_progress``; ``cwd`` adds ``cwd`` / ``branch``; ``personality`` adds ``history_reset`` /
``info``; ``yolo`` reports its ``scope``. ``value`` is a bool only for the display toggles.
ConfigSetResult.title: ConfigSetResult

ConnectionAnswer.description:
The card's answer: per-target outcomes and an optional Continue
(``settled_by: "continue"``). Settlement is derived from target states afterwards.
ConnectionAnswer.title: ConnectionAnswer

ConnectionAnswerTarget.description:
One row's answer from the card. ``status`` is what the card observed for that row
(``tools/connectors/mcp.py::_OUTCOME_STATES`` maps it onto a target state); ``state`` is the
older spelling of the same field and one of the two is present.
ConnectionAnswerTarget.title: ConnectionAnswerTarget

ConnectionOperationTarget.description:
``Target.snapshot``: the link minted up front rides here, never in the model result. ``extra``
keys a leg records (``tools``, ``hint``) are typed here as they appear.
ConnectionOperationTarget.title: ConnectionOperationTarget

ConnectionRequestPayload.description:
``ConnectionOperation.request_payload``: opens the card; also the ``pending_connection`` resume
snapshot so a client that missed the event restores the card with the server's deadline.
ConnectionRequestPayload.title: ConnectionRequestPayload

ConnectionUpdatePayload.description:
``methods_connectors._connection_update``: one target transition (``target``/``from``/``to``/
``actor``) or the settlement (none of those), with the full snapshot.
ConnectionUpdatePayload.title: ConnectionUpdatePayload

ConnectorRow.description:
One ``manage_connections`` status entry after ``connector_ui_payload`` redaction; the
connector service owns the closed key set, so unknown metadata passes through.
ConnectorRow.title: ConnectorRow

ConnectorsConnectResult.description:
The operation the connect opened (or re-minted on): ``tools/connectors/managed.py``
``_off_desktop_result`` / ``methods_connectors._reissue``. ``status``/``note`` ride along from
the tool result when the call ran through ``manage_connections``.
ConnectorsConnectResult.title: ConnectorsConnectResult

CronManageResult.description:
Pass-through of ``tools/cronjob_tools.py::cronjob`` JSON: ``list`` → ``jobs``/``count``
(+ ``scoped`` when profile-scoped); ``add`` → the created job's summary + ``job``; ``remove`` →
``removed_job``; ``pause``/``resume`` → ``job``. A tool-level failure lands in ``error``.
CronManageResult.title: CronManageResult

DiagnosticsShareNousResult.description: Structured envelope: ``ok=False`` + ``error`` renders inline instead of failing the RPC.
DiagnosticsShareNousResult.title: DiagnosticsShareNousResult

DiscoveredRepo.description: ``methods_projects._discover_repos_payload`` row: a git root with session totals.
DiscoveredRepo.title: DiscoveredRepo

ErrorSurface.description: ``agent/error_surface.py::_surface`` — advisory {layer, code, retryable} (+ identity, + auth hint).
ErrorSurface.title: ErrorSurface

FileAttachParams.description:
``path`` when the file is gateway-visible, else ``data_url`` carries the bytes; ``name`` labels
an uploaded file.
FileAttachParams.title: FileAttachParams

ForeignSessionRow.description:
``hermes_cli/foreign_sessions_browser.py::list_foreign_sessions`` — ``id`` is an opaque
handle, never a path.
ForeignSessionRow.title: ForeignSessionRow

FreeTierStatusResult.description:
``available`` = an identity exists AND the tier is on; whether inference runs on it is
``setup.runtime_check.free_tier``'s question.
FreeTierStatusResult.title: FreeTierStatusResult

GroupsApproveResult.description: ``result`` is the local ``approval.respond`` answer or the peer's run-action receipt.
GroupsApproveResult.title: GroupsApproveResult

HandoffFailResult.description: ``failed`` false when the watcher already claimed the row; ``state`` is what it is now.
HandoffFailResult.title: HandoffFailResult

HandoffStateResult.description: ``state`` is pending | running | completed | failed, or '' when nothing was requested.
HandoffStateResult.title: HandoffStateResult

ImageAttachBytesParams.description:
``content_base64`` (or the ``data`` alias) carries the bytes; ``filename`` / ``ext`` only hint
the extension — magic bytes decide.
ImageAttachBytesParams.title: ImageAttachBytesParams

ImageGenerateResult.description:
``probe`` answers ``{available}`` alone; ``image_data`` (data URL) is omitted when the
download failed or exceeded ``max_bytes`` so callers fall back to ``image``.
ImageGenerateResult.title: ImageGenerateResult

InflightTurn.description:
``session_auto_continue._inflight_snapshot``: the live (or retained failed) turn a reconnecting
client rebuilds its bubbles from.
InflightTurn.title: InflightTurn

InputDetectDropResult.description:
``matched: false`` alone when the text is not a drop; an image drop is queued immediately
(``is_image`` + ``count``), a file drop only yields the ``text`` to insert.
InputDetectDropResult.title: InputDetectDropResult

LearningFrame.description:
``agent.learning_graph_render.render_graph`` projection; ``grid`` rows are lists of
``[text, styleKey, alpha?, hexOverride?]`` runs.
LearningFrame.title: LearningFrame

LlmOneshotParams.description: Needs a ``template`` or ``instructions`` / ``input``; a live ``session_id`` lends its model.
LlmOneshotParams.title: LlmOneshotParams

LoopSnapshot.description: ``_safe_loop_snapshot`` — persisted LoopState fields, never its route.
LoopSnapshot.title: LoopSnapshot

McpOauthFlowParams.description: ``session_id`` is the OAuth flow id returned by ``oauth.start`` (not a gateway session).
McpOauthFlowParams.title: McpOauthFlowParams

McpOauthStartParams.description:
With ``client_redirect_uri`` the CLIENT hosts the loopback and relays the code via
``mcp.servers.oauth.callback``.
McpOauthStartParams.title: McpOauthStartParams

McpServerSummary.description: ``tui_gateway/mcp_rpc_helpers.summarize_server`` — a server's config without secret values.
McpServerSummary.title: McpServerSummary

McpServersAddParams.description:
``preset`` (catalog id) and/or ``config`` (url/command/args/env/headers/auth/tools); a
``bearer_token`` is written to the profile's .env, only the header template persists.
McpServersAddParams.title: McpServersAddParams

McpServersTestResult.description: ``ok: false`` carries ``error``; ``prompts`` / ``resources`` are only counted on success.
McpServersTestResult.title: McpServersTestResult

MessageReactParams.description:
``row_id`` is ``messages.id``; a not-yet-persisted live message names ``newest_role`` instead.
``emoji`` null clears; the same emoji again retracts.
MessageReactParams.title: MessageReactParams

MessageReaction.description:
One persisted reaction row (``hermes_state_messages.set_message_reaction``); ``seen`` is
stamped once announced.
MessageReaction.title: MessageReaction

ModelOptionProvider.description:
One ``hermes_cli/inventory.py::build_models_payload`` provider row (the union of every field
the builder sets; ``pricing_pending`` / ``free_tier_pending`` mark the cached-only path).
ModelOptionProvider.title: ModelOptionProvider

ModelPricing.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_pricing`` — formatted $/Mtok strings (``""`` unknown,
``"free"``); the sale fields are Nous Portal-only.
ModelPricing.title: ModelPricing

NotificationShowPayload.description:
``agent/credits_tracker.py::AgentNotice`` via notice_callback, and ``server._await_agent_ready``'s
slow-build notice. ``level``: info | warn | error | success; ``kind``: sticky | ttl | agent.
NotificationShowPayload.title: NotificationShowPayload

OpenRequestEntry.description:
One unanswered server→client request (``server_requests.Request.snapshot``); the reconnecting
client re-delivers it to its request handlers.
OpenRequestEntry.title: OpenRequestEntry

PdfAttachParams.description:
Host ``path`` or base64 ``content_base64`` / ``data``; ``first_page`` / ``last_page`` bound the
render (per-call page cap enforced server-side).
PdfAttachParams.title: PdfAttachParams

PendingApproval.description:
One unresolved ``tools/approval.py`` gateway queue entry as ``server._approval_request_payload``
renders it (command redacted; ``choices`` precomputed). The key set is owned by the approval tool.
PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval

PetCellsParams.description: ``graphics`` opts into the kitty payload when the TTY speaks it; ``cols`` overrides the width.
PetCellsParams.title: PetCellsParams

PetCellsResult.description:
Unicode: ``frames`` is frame → row → cell ``[tr,tg,tb,ta, br,bg,bb,ba]``; kitty (``graphics``
set): ``frames`` are transmit escapes and ``placeholder`` the text grid.
PetCellsResult.title: PetCellsResult

PetGenerateParams.description: ``prompt`` or a ``referenceImage`` data URL is required (the handler answers 4004 without one).
PetGenerateParams.title: PetGenerateParams

PetGenerateProgressPayload.description: ``methods_session`` pet.generate: token-only init frame, then one per draft.
PetGenerateProgressPayload.title: PetGenerateProgressPayload

PetHatchProgressPayload.description: ``methods_session`` pet.hatch ``_on_progress``: ``{event, detail}`` or the parsed row form.
PetHatchProgressPayload.title: PetHatchProgressPayload

PetHatchResult.description: The hatched pet is installed but NOT active (``pet.select`` adopts, ``pet.remove`` discards).
PetHatchResult.title: PetHatchResult

PetInfoParams.description: ``knownRevision``: the spritesheet revision the caller already holds (send-once bytes).
PetInfoParams.title: PetInfoParams

PetInfoResult.description:
``server._pet_sprite_payload`` behind ``enabled``; every sprite field is absent when the pet
display is off, ``spritesheetBase64`` is elided when ``spritesheetUnchanged``.
PetInfoResult.title: PetInfoResult

PetThumbParams.description: ``url``: spritesheet source for a not-yet-installed pet.
PetThumbParams.title: PetThumbParams

ProcessKillResult.description: ``tools/process_registry.py::kill_process`` snapshot; ``error`` rides on the failure statuses.
ProcessKillResult.title: ProcessKillResult

ProfileCanonicalSession.description: The profile's "Bot Chat" registry row; ``resolved_id`` is the live compression tip.
ProfileCanonicalSession.title: ProfileCanonicalSession

ProfileMirrored.description: What was copied from the launch profile.
ProfileMirrored.title: ProfileMirrored

ProfileParams.description: Any method the desktop may route to a named profile (``requestGatewayForProfile`` adds ``profile``).
ProfileParams.title: ProfileParams

ProfileRow.description: One roster row; the session fields are present only with ``include_sessions``.
ProfileRow.title: ProfileRow

ProfileSessionPreview.description: Newest human-facing session of a profile (``_latest_profile_session_rows``).
ProfileSessionPreview.title: ProfileSessionPreview

ProfileWorkerSession.description: Newest kanban/tool worker row, so rosters can show a profile as working.
ProfileWorkerSession.title: ProfileWorkerSession

ProfilesConfigureApplied.description: Per-section outcome; only the sections the request carried are present.
ProfilesConfigureApplied.title: ProfilesConfigureApplied

ProfilesConfigureParams.description: Sections are independent; ``ui_meta_expected_revisions`` is a per-key compare-and-swap.
ProfilesConfigureParams.title: ProfilesConfigureParams

ProfilesConfigureResult.description: ``confirm_required`` mirrors ``config.set``: a guarded model pick wrote nothing yet.
ProfilesConfigureResult.title: ProfilesConfigureResult

ProfilesCreateParams.description:
``clone_from`` omitted = fresh profile + bundled skills; ``mirror_credentials`` defaults on
so a headless bot has a provider.
ProfilesCreateParams.title: ProfilesCreateParams

ProfilesDescribeResult.description: Editor snapshot; ``toolsets_pinned`` says whether ``tools.enabled_toolsets`` is explicit.
ProfilesDescribeResult.title: ProfilesDescribeResult

ProfilesGetAssetResult.description: Absent is ``found: false``, not an error.
ProfilesGetAssetResult.title: ProfilesGetAssetResult

ProfilesListResult.description: ``bot_mode_protocol`` tells clients this backend injects the teammate protocol itself.
ProfilesListResult.title: ProfilesListResult

ProfilesSetAssetParams.description: ``data`` is a data URL or bare base64 (PNG/JPEG/WebP, sniffed); ``clear`` deletes instead.
ProfilesSetAssetParams.title: ProfilesSetAssetParams

ProjectFactsResult.description: ``facts`` null outside a workspace (or when detection failed).
ProjectFactsResult.title: ProjectFactsResult

ProjectIdParams.description: Any method addressed at one stored project (``5062`` when the id resolves to nothing).
ProjectIdParams.title: ProjectIdParams

ProjectInfo.description: ``hermes_cli/projects_db.py::Project.to_dict`` — one stored project with its folders.
ProjectInfo.title: ProjectInfo

ProjectTreeLane.description: One branch / worktree / kanban lane inside a repo; ``sessions`` is empty unless hydrated.
ProjectTreeLane.title: ProjectTreeLane

ProjectTreeNode.description: ``project_tree._project_node`` — explicit, auto (git root) or the synthetic Home bucket.
ProjectTreeNode.title: ProjectTreeNode

ProjectTreeSession.description:
``methods_projects._project_tree_row`` + ``project_tree.stamp_profile``: the minimal row the
sidebar renders, stamped with the profile it belongs to.
ProjectTreeSession.title: ProjectTreeSession

ProjectsDiscoverReposParams.description: ``scan`` asks the host to walk the policy roots itself (remote-gateway desktop).
ProjectsDiscoverReposParams.title: ProjectsDiscoverReposParams

ProjectsForCwdParams.description: Absent ``cwd`` resolves the gateway's default completion cwd.
ProjectsForCwdParams.title: ProjectsForCwdParams

ProjectsPayload.description: ``methods_projects._projects_payload``: every project (archived included) + the active id.
ProjectsPayload.title: ProjectsPayload

ProjectsRecordReposParams.description: Repos as ``{root, label}`` objects or bare root strings; entries without a root are skipped.
ProjectsRecordReposParams.title: ProjectsRecordReposParams

ProjectsSetActiveParams.description: No ``id`` (or null) clears the active project.
ProjectsSetActiveParams.title: ProjectsSetActiveParams

ProjectsUpdateParams.description: Absent keys are left untouched; ``''`` clears ``color`` / ``icon``.
ProjectsUpdateParams.title: ProjectsUpdateParams

PromptSubmitParams.description:
``text`` is normally a string; the relay / hosted paths may hand a structured (parts list)
payload, and the busy path renders it. Truncation (rewind / edit / regenerate) needs explicit
consent: ``confirm_truncate`` plus one durable target (``truncate_before_row_id`` preferred,
``truncate_before_message_id``, or the legacy ``truncate_before_user_ordinal``).
PromptSubmitParams.title: PromptSubmitParams

PromptSubmitResult.description:
``status`` is absent only on the typed-stop-phrase reply (``voice_stopped``). After a
truncation the survivor row ids let the client rebind its cached ``rowId``s (``None`` map
entries: drop the cached id). ``turn_isolation`` marks a compute-host dispatch.
PromptSubmitResult.title: PromptSubmitResult

RelayAgentRow.description:
A roster row the Desktop pushes (``tools/bot_relay.py::_normalize_roster_row``); invalid
rows are dropped server-side, so the shape stays open.
RelayAgentRow.title: RelayAgentRow

ReloadMcpParams.description:
Without ``confirm`` the handler may answer ``confirm_required`` (per ``approvals.mcp_reload_confirm``);
``always`` persists the opt-out; ``rev`` is the config revision the caller wants loaded (coalescing).
ReloadMcpParams.title: ReloadMcpParams

RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams.description: The policy the desktop scanned under (short or ``repo_scan_*`` long keys both accepted).
RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams.title: RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams

RollbackRestoreResult.description:
``tools/checkpoint_manager.py::restore`` outcome; ``history_removed`` is added for a full
(non-file) restore that also rewound the live transcript.
RollbackRestoreResult.title: RollbackRestoreResult

Room.description:
``gateway/hosted_rooms.py::_room_from_row`` plus the branch-only keys ``create`` (legacy
adoption), ``state`` (``authority_claim``) and ``rename`` (``event``) add.
Room.title: Room

RoomDriverStatus.description:
``HostedRoomService.status(room_id)``; ``pending_actions`` rows are ``{kind: retry, task_id}``
or the driver's approval action (``kind: approval`` + run/session/approval context).
RoomDriverStatus.title: RoomDriverStatus

RoomMember.description:
One roster row (``hosted_room_discussion.validate_roster``); legacy rooms may carry
pre-normalisation rows, so the set stays open.
RoomMember.title: RoomMember

RoomMemberInput.description: A roster row as the client proposes it; ``validate_roster`` owns the exact rules.
RoomMemberInput.title: RoomMemberInput

SeedMessage.description:
One create-time transcript row (``session_history._coerce_seed_history``); ``text`` is the
legacy alias of ``content``; only ``display_kind: "hidden"`` is accepted from the wire. Clients
forward stored rows verbatim (``_row_id``, ``timestamp``, …) and the coercer drops what it does
not use, so the row stays open.
SeedMessage.title: SeedMessage

SessionCompressResult.description:
In-process: the before/after summary + replacement transcript. Compute host: its result passes
through (hence open) with ``turn_isolation``; a lock held elsewhere answers ``compressed: false``.
SessionCompressResult.title: SessionCompressResult

SessionContextBreakdownResult.description:
``agent.context_breakdown.compute_session_context_breakdown`` (empty categories before the agent builds)
plus the per-file context manifest (empty until the agent exists).
SessionContextBreakdownResult.title: SessionContextBreakdownResult

SessionControlDispatch.description: ``_dispatch_envelope`` — the command result's user-visible envelope, every key always present.
SessionControlDispatch.title: SessionControlDispatch

SessionControlParams.description:
``action`` is validated by the handler (unknown / gate actions answer ``4004``), so it stays a
string on the wire; ``SessionControlAction`` lists the accepted set.
SessionControlParams.title: SessionControlParams

SessionControlSnapshot.description:
``_snapshot_control`` — ``revision`` is a hash of the visible state (``""`` when empty);
``updated_at`` is the newest persisted timestamp (``0`` when none).
SessionControlSnapshot.title: SessionControlSnapshot

SessionCwdSetResult.description: The refreshed ``session.info`` view (full agent view, or the lazy shape).
SessionCwdSetResult.title: SessionCwdSetResult

SessionForeignListResult.description: ``unreadable`` counts logs on this page that failed to parse.
SessionForeignListResult.title: SessionForeignListResult

SessionForeignPreviewResult.description: Bounded to the last 40 turns / 8000 chars each; ``already_imported`` is the local id.
SessionForeignPreviewResult.title: SessionForeignPreviewResult

SessionListRow.description:
``methods_session._session_row_summary``; ``resolved_id`` only on a title lookup that followed a
compression lineage to its tip.
SessionListRow.title: SessionListRow

SessionLiveInfo.description:
``tui_gateway/server.py::_session_info`` — the ``session.info`` event and the ``info`` field of
``session.create`` / ``session.resume`` / ``session.activate`` results.
SessionLiveInfo.title: SessionLiveInfo

SessionParams.description: Any method addressed at one live session.
SessionParams.title: SessionParams

SessionResumeParams.description: ``session_id`` is the STORED id (or an exact title); the reply's ``session_id`` is the runtime id.
SessionResumeParams.title: SessionResumeParams

SessionSaveResult.description: Under turn isolation the compute host's result passes through verbatim.
SessionSaveResult.title: SessionSaveResult

SessionSetHiddenParams.description: ``session_id`` is a live runtime id first, else a stored id / key / title.
SessionSetHiddenParams.title: SessionSetHiddenParams

SetupRuntimeCheckResult.description:
``ok=False`` + ``error`` when the resolved model can't be served; ``free_tier`` says the
selected route is the welcome host.
SetupRuntimeCheckResult.title: SetupRuntimeCheckResult

SetupStatusResult.description:
``provider_configured`` is the loose answer; the boot record's fields (``ready``,
``free_tier``, ``other_providers``, ``inference_provider``) ride along on the launch profile.
An unknown ``profile`` answers ``ok=False`` + ``error``.
SetupStatusResult.title: SetupStatusResult

SkillsManageParams.description:
``query`` is the search text / hub identifier / browse page (digits); ``page`` / ``page_size``
apply to ``browse``.
SkillsManageParams.title: SkillsManageParams

SkillsManageResult.description:
Shape follows the action: ``list`` → ``skills`` (category → names); ``search`` → ``results``;
``install`` → ``installed`` + ``name``; ``browse`` → ``items`` + paging; ``inspect`` → ``info``.
SkillsManageResult.title: SkillsManageResult

SkinPayload.description:
``tui_gateway/change_watcher.py::resolve_skin`` — the resolved active skin (``HermesSkin``).
``{}`` when the skin engine failed to load. Colour maps are token → colour string.
SkinPayload.title: SkinPayload

SlashExecResult.description:
Plain worker/plugin text in ``output`` (+ ``warning``), or — when the command was rerouted to
``command.dispatch`` — that method's directive fields with ``type`` set.
SlashExecResult.title: SlashExecResult

SpawnTreeEntry.description: Index row (``server._append_spawn_tree_index``) or a legacy file scan.
SpawnTreeEntry.title: SpawnTreeEntry

SpawnTreeLoadResult.description: The snapshot file as written by ``spawn_tree.save`` (open: the file is the contract).
SpawnTreeLoadResult.title: SpawnTreeLoadResult

StatusUpdatePayload.description: ``server._status_update`` and the direct emitters (goal / loop / heartbeat / process).
StatusUpdatePayload.title: StatusUpdatePayload

StreamDeltaPayload.description:
``prompt_turn._invoke_agent._stream`` (message.delta: ``text`` + optional ``rendered``),
``agent_callbacks._agent_cbs`` (reasoning.delta / thinking.delta), ``tool_progress._progress_reasoning``
(reasoning.available). ``verbose`` rides only when the session's verbose reasoning mode is on.
StreamDeltaPayload.title: StreamDeltaPayload

SubagentEventPayload.description:
``tool_progress._progress_subagent`` — every ``subagent.*`` frame; identity fields are optional
because older emitters omit them and the TUI spawn tree falls back to flat rendering.
SubagentEventPayload.title: SubagentEventPayload

SubagentListResult.description: ``delegations`` is reserved for async delegation records and is currently always empty.
SubagentListResult.title: SubagentListResult

SubagentSnapshot.description: ``methods_subagents._SUBAGENT_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS`` projection of one live child record.
SubagentSnapshot.title: SubagentSnapshot

SubagentStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one delegated child (``tools/delegate_tool_child_run.py``); ``failed`` /
``error`` / ``timeout`` / ``interrupted`` / ``completed`` are terminal.
SubagentStatus.title: SubagentStatus

SubagentSteerResult.description: ``queued`` is not ``delivered``: a child past its final tool batch surfaces ``missed_steer``.
SubagentSteerResult.title: SubagentSteerResult

SubagentTailResult.description: ``available`` is false while the child has no live transcript yet (or it was cleaned up).
SubagentTailResult.title: SubagentTailResult

SubscriptionChangeParams.description: Either a target tier (downgrade / same-price change) or ``cancel`` (period-end cancellation).
SubscriptionChangeParams.title: SubscriptionChangeParams

SubscriptionPreviewResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_preview`` on success; ``effect`` drives the confirm copy.
SubscriptionPreviewResult.title: SubscriptionPreviewResult

SubscriptionStateResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_state``; the view's fallback emits only ``ok / logged_in / error``.
SubscriptionStateResult.title: SubscriptionStateResult

SubscriptionUpgradeResult.description:
The money route: ``status`` separates a completed upgrade from an SCA / decline that must
finish in the portal at ``recovery_url``; ``idempotency_key`` is echoed (also on error) so a
retry reuses it.
SubscriptionUpgradeResult.title: SubscriptionUpgradeResult

SudoRequestParams.description: Original command, redacted server-side before any password-injection rewrite.
SudoRequestParams.title: SudoRequestParams

TaskIdResult.description:
The side agent runs detached; its answer lands on the parent session as an event carrying
this ``task_id``.
TaskIdResult.title: TaskIdResult

ToolCompletePayload.description: ``tool_progress._on_tool_complete``; ``todos``/``revision`` merged in for the todo tools.
ToolCompletePayload.title: ToolCompletePayload

ToolStartPayload.description:
``tool_progress._on_tool_start`` (+ ``agent_callbacks._mirror_subagent_to_child`` rows with
``preview`` and empty ``args``). ``todos``/``revision`` are NOT set by the emitter; kept optional
because tool.start rows may pass through connector redaction unchanged.
ToolStartPayload.title: ToolStartPayload

ToolsConfigureParams.description:
``names`` are toolset keys or ``server:tool`` MCP targets; with ``session_id`` the live session's
profile is authoritative and its agent is rebuilt.
ToolsConfigureParams.title: ToolsConfigureParams

ToolsetRow.description:
One row of ``methods_tools._toolset_rows``; ``tools`` only when the caller asked for them
(``tools.list``).
ToolsetRow.title: ToolsetRow

TranscriptMessage.description:
One transcript row as the gateway PROJECTS it for renderers (``session_history._project_history``):
``text`` (never ``content``), display-only ``timestamp`` / ``display_kind`` / ``display_metadata``, the
durable ``row_id`` rewind targets, and for tool rows ``name`` + ``context`` preview + full ``args``.

TranscriptMessage.title: TranscriptMessage

UsageBar.description: ``_serialize_usage_bar``: one bar, magnitudes pre-formatted; ``pct_used`` only for ``plan``.

UsageModel.description:
``_serialize_usage_model`` — also embedded as ``usage`` in the billing / subscription states,
where the fail-open form is a bare ``{available: false}`` (no ``ok``).
UsageModel.title: UsageModel

ValueResult.description:
The answer to any one-string prompt (sudo, secret, vault prompts, desktop bridges):
``''`` means skipped / declined.
ValueResult.title: ValueResult

VaultAddParams.description: ``secret`` goes straight into the encrypted store; the result carries only the new id.
VaultAddParams.title: VaultAddParams

VaultUnlockParams.description: The master password is consumed by the manager CLI and never stored or logged.
VaultUnlockParams.title: VaultUnlockParams

VerificationStatusInfo.description:
``verification_status()``: ``disabled`` / ``not_applicable`` / ``unverified`` / ``stale`` or the
latest event's own status; ``root`` and friends only once a workspace was identified.
VerificationStatusInfo.title: VerificationStatusInfo

VoiceStatusPayload.description: ``methods_voice._vr_on_status``; states come from the recorder (idle / listening / transcribing …).
VoiceStatusPayload.title: VoiceStatusPayload

VoiceToggleResult.description:
``methods_voice.py::_voice_status_payload`` (+ the requirements probe on ``status``, the spoken
stop hint on ``on``).
VoiceToggleResult.title: VoiceToggleResult

WakeFeedParams.description: ``pcm`` (or the ``pcm_b64`` alias): base64 int16 mono little-endian, 16 kHz only.
WakeFeedParams.title: WakeFeedParams

WakeInputDevice.description: ``tools/wake_word.py::_describe_input_device`` — PortAudio diagnostics for the configured mic.
WakeInputDevice.title: WakeInputDevice

WakeStartParams.description:
``surface`` names the caller ("tui" | "gui"); ``persist`` is the explicit gesture that also
flips ``wake_word.enabled`` on; ``client_capture`` asks for PCM streamed via wake.feed.
WakeStartParams.title: WakeStartParams

WakeStartResult.description:
``started: false`` carries ``reason`` (unavailable / disabled / disabled_for_surface / owned);
``sample_rate`` / ``frame_length`` describe the PCM frames the armed detector expects.
WakeStartResult.title: WakeStartResult

WakeStatusResult.description:
``enabled`` is config truth; ``listening`` is this caller's armed detector; ``audio_silent``
means armed but deaf (see ``hint``).
WakeStatusResult.title: WakeStatusResult

_SessionScoped.description:
Handlers that look a live session up with ``_sessions.get(params.get("session_id"))``: an
absent / unknown id falls back to the launch profile's config, so it is never required.
_SessionScoped.title: _SessionScoped
